Name: Simple Crop Reseed
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][b][size=5][color=#FDE68A]Mod Requested By:[/color] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Harold45][color=#D8B4FE]Harold45[/color][/url][/size][/b][/center]
[center][size=6][b][color=#D8B4FE]🌱 Simple Crop Reseed[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Harvest normally. Cleared crop tiles replant using [b]one matching seed from your backpack[/b]. Your selected tool stays selected.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53712/53712-1791655713-182467174.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]🌾 Features[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]• Hand and native scythe harvesting, including the Iridium Scythe.[/center]
[center]• Regrowing plants stay in place. Missing seeds leave the tile empty.[/center]
[center]• Seeds can be anywhere in your ordinary backpack; chests and virtual bags are excluded.[/center]
[center]• Native watering, fertilizer, growth, quality and harvest XP rules remain.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]⚙️ Optional settings[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Enable reseeding [b]On[/b] • Seed reserve [b]0[/b] • Skip summaries [b]On[/b] • Pause key [b]Unassigned[/b].[/center]
[center][b]Season protection: On.[/b] Assumes daily watering without speed bonuses and requires maturity by day 28; may skip viable multi-season crops. Year-round growing areas bypass it.[/center]
[center]Change settings through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or config.json. No hotkey is required.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]🧩 Requirements[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b]Desktop single-player[/b] • Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15+[/b] • Compatible [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] [b]4.0+[/b]. GMCM is optional.[/center]
[center][b]1.0 test candidate:[/b] gameplay confirmation is pending; test on a copied save. Android is unsupported; reseeding disables itself in multiplayer/split-screen.[/center]
[center]Excludes pots, wild-seed crops, giant crops and unattended harvesters. Mods replacing normal harvest or planting need separate compatibility testing.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]📥 Install[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]1. Install a compatible SMAPI release.[/center]
[center]2. Extract [b]SimpleCropReseed[/b] into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b].[/center]
[center]3. Launch through SMAPI, carry matching seeds and harvest.[/center]
[center]To uninstall, remove the mod folder. Planted crops remain.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]💬 Support[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Report the crop, seed, season, harvesting method and settings with a fresh [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url]. Settings and messages support all 12 game languages.[/center]
[center][b]Credits:[/b] ConcernedApe; [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI / Pathoschild[/url]; [url=https://github.com/pardeike/Harmony]Harmony / Andreas Pardeike[/url]; [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM / spacechase0[/url] and contributors. AI assisted. Images are illustrations.[/center]
